bull_bear.body:
- Capital position stated at CRAR 17.15% (Tier 1: 16.10% | Tier 2: 1.05%), with CET 1 shown at 16.10% in Q1 FY27; the deck notes Q1, Q2 and Q3 FY26 CRAR/CET1 exclude interim profits.
- Liquidity is held well above requirement with average LCR at 127% and RWA to Assets at 73%.
- Provisioning philosophy is conservative on the stated numbers: specific provision of Rs.7,678crs, floating provisions of Rs.70crs, standard asset provisions of Rs.1,810crs including restructured, PCR at 71% and total loan related provisions at 88% of GNPA — Rs.9,558crs, or 2.93% of loans.
- Book Value Per Share of Rs.832 and net worth of Rs.64,798crs, both up 3% YoY and 3% QoQ; borrowings were reduced 16% YoY to Rs.43,864crs.
- Shareholding is diversified: MFs/Banks/Insurance Co 40.26%, FIIs 27.81%, Promoters 15.08%, Individuals 7.85%, GDR issue 4.64%, Private Corporates 2.46%, NRIs/Director/Others 1.90%. The deck makes no dividend statement.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Described as the "5th Largest Private Bank" with "Universal Offerings": 42mn customers, 9,413 touch points, deposits of Rs.4,14,766crs and loans of Rs.3,26,274crs.
- Loan book split at end of Q1 FY27 is Retail 50%, SME 13% and Wholesale 37%, which the deck frames as "Loan Book Diversified Across Customer Segments".
- Vehicle Finance is claimed as a franchise with "35+ Years of Vintage", "Market Leader in Most Products", nationwide diversified presence and healthy collateral coverage.
- Rural franchise is positioned on distribution depth: ~1,60,000 villages served across 23 States, 85K+ active Bharat Money Stores, 575K borrowing merchants and 27K+ unique farmers.
- Wholesale Banking is described as "Driven by Risk Adjusted Return on Capital", as primary banker to emerging and mid corporates with an ingrained liability approach and annuity-led fees.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Asset quality trajectory] Stress pools moderated across every disclosed measure: GNPA 3.25% vs 3.43% QoQ, NNPA 0.95% vs 1.00%, SMA1 & SMA2 0.12% vs 0.17%, restructured book 0.05% vs 0.06% and net security receipts 0.07% vs 0.08%; PCR held at 71%.
- [NPA movement] Gross NPA fell to Rs.10,849crs from Rs.11,095crs, with fresh additions of Rs.1,660crs against deductions of Rs.1,907crs of which write-offs were Rs.1,435crs; sale to ARCs/others was nil in all five quarters shown.
- [Corporate risk profile] Rating-wise corporate exposure (fund and non-fund) improved over Jun-25 to Jun-26: AAA 15%, AA 33%, A 35%, BBB 17%, BB+ & Below 1% as of Jun-26 versus BB+ & Below 3% in Jun-25.
- [Credit ratings] Domestic: CARE A1+ and CRISIL A1+ for CD/short-term programmes, CRISIL AA+ for Infrastructure Bonds/Tier 2 Bonds, IND AA+ issuer and senior/Tier 2 by India Ratings; International: Ba1 for the Senior Unsecured MTN programme by Moody's.
- [Awards] 'Platinum' at Infosys Finacle Innovation Award 2026 for 'INDIE for MSMEs - Digital Current Account Opening Platform', and 6 wins in 'Best Supply Chain Solution' at The Asset Triple A Treasurise Awards 2026 — the 8th consecutive year of that recognition.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions IndusInd Bank as the 5th largest private bank in India with universal offerings, 42mn customers and 9,413 touch points, pivoting "towards growth from consolidation" on a retailising liability franchise while stress pools moderate.
